objective: Report follow-up evidence that the commerce-control MCP integration is now fully working natively in Hermes.
summary: The previous native MCP limitation is resolved. In a live Hermes session, all 11 commerce-control MCP tools are available and commerce_status succeeded through the native Hermes MCP tool, confirming Mode A with externalWritesEnabled=false, liveValueMovementEnabled=false, walletSecretPresent=false, 68 services, and 44 work records. Root cause was Termux stdio ENOENT when executing the MCP wrapper directly; the fix is launching the wrapper via Termux bash. No financial or external-mutation action was taken.
root_cause: Hermes' Termux stdio watchdog could not directly execute ~/.hermes/commerce-control/commerce-control-mcp.sh and returned ENOENT.
fix: Register the MCP server with Termux bash as the executable and the wrapper script as its argument.
requested_action: Independent review of the follow-up runtime evidence; no B1/B2 activation requested.
limitations: Stage B1 and B2 remain unimplemented and inactive.
No payment, claim, submission, publication, wallet, Coinbase, or other financial/external-write operation was performed.
